label: Believes the model understands meaning like a person
description: The learner treats the model as a mind that reads, reasons, and knows things, rather than machinery that computes predictions from weights.

remediation.explanation: A model computes a prediction from numbers. There is no reader inside and no understanding in the human sense; fluency is the output, not evidence of comprehension.

label: Thinks training uploaded a searchable corpus into the model
description: The learner imagines the model stores its training documents and looks answers up in them at query time.

remediation.explanation: Training adjusted weights by nudging next-token guesses toward better scores. The documents were never stored; only the adjustment remains.

label: Assumes one token equals one word
description: The learner counts tokens as words and is surprised by context limits, pricing, and letter-counting failures.

remediation.explanation: A token is a statistical piece of text: part of a word, a whole word, or punctuation. Common strings stay whole; rare ones split.

label: Believes the context window is unlimited
description: The learner expects a chat to hold everything forever and is confused when early instructions stop having effect.

remediation.explanation: The context window caps the payload in tokens. When a chat outgrows it, the earliest text is dropped and the model answers as though it never saw it.

label: Believes the model remembers you between calls
description: The learner thinks the model itself stores past conversations and learns from them.

remediation.explanation: The model is stateless. Any memory is a transcript an app keeps and resends; a fresh chat is an empty list.

label: Believes temperature controls truthfulness
description: The learner treats temperature as an accuracy dial, raising or lowering it to make answers more true.

remediation.explanation: Temperature changes how adventurous token sampling is, not what the model knows. Truth is untouched either way.

label: Expects identical output for identical prompts
description: The learner assumes the same prompt always yields the same answer and treats differences as bugs or deceit.

remediation.explanation: Generation samples from next-token scores. Unless temperature is 0 and the setup is fixed, consecutive runs differ by design.

label: Believes bigger models are always better
description: The learner picks the largest model available regardless of task, memory, or cost.

remediation.explanation: Size is a trade between capability and memory and speed. For simple, well-scoped work a small model can be the better choice; the task decides.

label: Believes local models require an expensive GPU
description: The learner assumes running any local model needs specialist hardware and never tries the small ones.

remediation.explanation: Small models like llama3.2:1b run on ordinary CPUs. Memory, not a GPU, decides what fits: roughly 1 GB per billion parameters at 4-bit.

label: Hunts for one magic prompt phrasing
description: The learner believes success comes from secret wording rather than supplying context, constraints, and examples, then iterating.

remediation.explanation: The model predicts from the patterns you supply. Missing context and vague instructions beat any phrasing trick; iterate instead of incanting.

label: Believes confabulation is a rare malfunction
description: The learner trusts fluent, confident answers by default and thinks invention only happens in odd edge cases.

remediation.explanation: A bare model with no source improvises in the same fluent voice as when it is right. Confabulation is ordinary behaviour, so consequential claims need external checks.

label: Believes requested citations are reliable
description: The learner treats citation-shaped strings as proof and skips opening the sources.

remediation.explanation: Citations are generated text like any other. Invented and misattributed references look exactly like real ones, so the check is opening them.

label: Equates a local-feeling app with local inference
description: The learner trusts an app's private branding without checking whether the model call leaves the machine.

remediation.explanation: The interface can be local while the thinking is hosted. Check the server address: localhost means your machine, anything else means read the terms.

label: Reaches for a model on every task
description: The learner hands exact arithmetic, deterministic processing, and high-stakes decisions to a text predictor.

remediation.explanation: Models predict plausible text. Exact outputs need deterministic tools - calculators, scripts, databases - and high-stakes decisions need evidence and a qualified human.
